Subject: Private/VPC technical deep-dive — proposal of slots & pre-call asks

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for a great discovery this morning. Quick recap of the parts that stood out from our side:
- Primary goal: run inference for PII-protected documents in a customer-controlled VPC with strict audit/logging requirements.
- Expected baseline: ~40 qps, burst to 120 qps; 80 token average sequences.
- Key constraints: on-prem KMS integration, SAML SSO for dev tooling, and a 30‑day request/response logging retention policy.

Next step: technical architecture review (60 min) with your infra and security leads to map network/topology and identify any blockers for the private deployment. Proposed outcomes: shared network diagram, list of ports/IPs for allowlist, and a rough rollout timeline.

Proposed 2x slots (PST):
- Wed Nov 10 — 09:00–10:00
- Thu Nov 11 — 13:00–14:00

If neither works, share two slots that suit Michael and the infra team. Can you also confirm who will own procurement and whether we should include your procurement contact on the invite?

Attaching quick post-call notes for your reference. Pre-call asks (short):
1) A simple network diagram (VPC/subnets, NAT/GW, VPN/Direct Connect).
2) Names & emails of infra/security attendees.
3) Any non‑standard egress restrictions or proxy requirements.

Happy to adjust agenda based on who joins.

Best,
Jordan Blake
